syllabus:
Practice.

If a record fails to present in proper form the questions argued by counsel, the judgment will be affirmed.
summary: IN ERROR TO THE SUPREME COURT OF THE TERRITORY OF MONTANA.
attorneys: Mr. E. W. Toole for plaintiff in error, submitted on his brief., Mr. Samuel Shellabarger for defendant in error.

opinions.author: Waite
opinions.text:
Mr. Chief Justice Waite

delivered the opinion of the court.

This judgment is affirmed. The record fails entirely to present in proper form any of the questions which have been argued for the plaintiff in error. Affirmed.
